description: Defines a Drupal field formatter plugin for rendering telephone links with customizable titles and handling short phone numbers.

classes.name: TelephoneLinkFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that formats telephone fields as clickable links with optional custom titles.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the formatter, including an optional title.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form allowing users to specify a custom link title.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current formatter settings for display in the admin UI.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates the renderable link elements for each telephone field item, handling short number formatting and URL creation.
